set.body:
Purpose

Make the existing scenario and external-parity evidence reproducible and enforceable before changing scientific APIs.

Scope

- Repair the stale public F-contrast fixture exporter after the Gale migration.
- Enforce the focused JVM/Scala.js module and scenario gates in CI.
- Consolidate duplicated scenario harness infrastructure and validate the manifest/receipt contract.
- Keep R and Python generation outside ordinary sbt PR tests; checked-in generated fixtures remain portable to Scala.js.

Phase acceptance criteria

- [ ] The external fixture exporter is current, deterministic, and passes its own check mode without changing numerical truth accidentally.
- [ ] Pull requests run hrf, hrf-laws, design, model, and fit on JVM and Scala.js plus manifest and fixture freshness checks.
- [ ] Active scenarios have validated IDs, suite paths, platform claims, allowed statuses, reference strategies, and acceptance commands.
- [ ] ScenarioResult remains the single truth value; undeclared caveats cannot pass CI.
- [ ] The shared harness has one authority with module-specific numeric adapters and no production dependency cycle.
- [ ] The phase closes only after its child tasks and the focused public-consumer scenario paths pass.
set.title: Phase 0: repair the first-level evidence boundary and scenario court
